title: Naaman Washes Seven Times
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big heart that makes a brave start, and tonight a proud general has to do something that feels too easy: Beau wants the big diving board, but he puts his face in and blows bubbles seven times, and then he floats all by himself.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because sometimes the simple thing is the brave thing. In Beau’s world today: at swim lessons the teacher says, “Put your face in and blow bubbles, seven times.” Beau wants to jump off the big diving board instead. Bubbles feel too easy, like something for babies. But he takes a breath, puts his face in, and counts all the way to seven. Then he floats all by himself! Just like Naaman dipping in the river seven times, Beau learned that doing the simple thing brings big blessings.
